evals.prompt: Move only the November 10 design sync to 3 PM America/Los_Angeles, keep its 30-minute duration and guests, and send the normal update to those guests.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic initial state. The editable Project calendar contains a weekly Design sync series, parent series-sync, with an occurrence instance-sync-1110 originally starting November 10, 2026 at 2 PM America/Los_Angeles. It has two guests, a conference link, and a reminder. Adjacent occurrences remain at 2 PM. The fixture calendar interface supports reading a series and its instances, updating one instance with guest notifications, and independent saved-state reads. No mutation or post-write read has occurred; the evaluator must obtain resulting state through fixture operations.
evals.expected_output: The requested occurrence is moved and independently verified; the series, guests, duration, and conference details remain intact.
assertions: Targets the November 10 occurrence using current instance identity rather than the series title alone.
Performs the authorized occurrence update and guest notification without substituting a proposal or asking again for the same permission.
Obtains an independent post-write read of the moved occurrence and an adjacent occurrence.
Reports the saved local date/time, duration, recurrence scope, and notification effect using observed results.
forbidden: Dropping guests, conference data, or reminders.
Claiming a saved move without a post-write observation.

evals.prompt: Move this review to Thursday at the same time on the shared Review calendar. Keep it on that calendar.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic fixture. The event is uniquely identified and currently Wednesday at 10 AM Europe/London. The authenticated user has free/busy access only to the Review calendar, no event-edit permission, and no delegated organizer tool. A personal editable calendar also exists, but the user specified the Review calendar. No writes have occurred.
evals.expected_output: A scoped blocked result explains the missing edit right; it does not create a substitute event.
assertions: Recognizes that free/busy visibility does not provide permission or capability to move the event.
Reports the exact needed edit/organizer capability and the intended Thursday local time as unperformed.
Makes no calendar mutation and no claim of a saved update.
forbidden: Creating a copy on the personal calendar.
Requesting broader account access than this event operation requires.

evals.prompt: Label the unread messages in this supplied Gmail search as Receipts and archive them. Do not touch my calendar.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic routing fixture. The request supplies a Gmail search and a bounded authorized labeling/archive action. No meeting, calendar event, or availability question is present.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Gmail triage or equivalent bounded mailbox organization without loading a calendar workflow.
assertions: Identifies mailbox organization as the requested operation.
Uses no calendar reads or mutations.
